conformance.rationale: The feature conformance suite probes the comma-list parse and CSSContainerRule conditionText; this page's CSSOM probe is aligned with it.

accessibility.rationale: Native slider and toggle buttons, observed-width is aria-live=polite, pills carry text state alongside color.
